auditoria.presentacion: Download the activity log for the Data Protection Officer.
auditoria.ayuda: Both dates are included, using UTC. Event types group actions by their area. The download includes the filtered log, the full chain between its boundaries, hashes and verification instructions. The proof may include identifiers from other events in the period to preserve the links. To establish its origin, ask IT for the verification points held separately.
auditoria.privacidad: The archive contains person and case identifiers and their links. These are personal data even without names. Keep it in an authorised location and share it only as agreed with the DPO.
auditoria.cargando: We are loading the people you can select.
auditoria.no_disponible: We could not prepare the download. Try again. If this continues, contact IT.
auditoria.sin_usuarios: No people are available for the filter. You can download all actions or system tasks.
auditoria.periodo_limite: Include up to 31 days. The archive allows up to 100,000 chain events and 64 MiB. If it reaches a limit or takes more than 30 seconds to prepare, choose a shorter period.
auditoria.expediente_ayuda: Optional. Enter the internal case identifier provided by the DPO.
auditoria.consecuencia: You will download a ZIP containing the log and its integrity proof. The export will be logged. The proof may include other events between the period boundaries.
auditoria.preparando: We are checking the chain and preparing the download.
auditoria.vacio: No events match your filters. We have downloaded an empty log and its verification.
auditoria.descargado: Download prepared with {cantidad} events. Keep the archive in an authorised location.
auditoria.fechas_invalidas: Check the dates. Choose up to 31 days with an end date on or after the start date.
auditoria.filtros_invalidos: Check the filters. Use the complete internal case identifier.
auditoria.ocupada: Two downloads are in progress. Wait for them to finish and try again.
auditoria.uso_verificador: Provide the ZIP file and, if available, both verification points held separately.
auditoria.fichero_invalido: We could not read the verification file.
auditoria.exportacion_verificada: The filtered log and chain match their hashes.
auditoria.instrucciones_verificacion:
This archive contains personal data: identifiers and links, without names or case contents. Use an authorised location. registro.csv or registro.json contains the selection; cadena.json contains the contiguous chain and may include other events. manifiesto.json stores filters, counts, SHA-256 hashes and the previous and final points.

On an authorised computer, from the project root:
go build -o verificar-exportacion ./cmd/verificar-exportacion
./verificar-exportacion /authorised/path/auditoria.zip

The key auditoria.exportacion_verificada with exit code 0 confirms chain consistency and that the log contains the complete selection within the segment. Exit code 1 means verification failed. To establish its origin, use points kept independently by IT:
./verificar-exportacion /authorised/path/auditoria.zip PREVIOUS_ID PREVIOUS_HASH FINAL_ID FINAL_HASH

Points from the same archive do not establish its origin: someone able to recompute all events and change both points could create another consistent chain. This proof covers the exported segment, not events outside it or technical recording times. Keep the manifest even for an empty log. Retention periods and the scope of links are agreed with the DPO through the DPIA.
auditoria.sello_no_coincide: The chain does not match the expected final point. Keep the original and contact IT.
auditoria.personas_no_disponibles: We could not load the people. Load them again. You can download all actions or system tasks.
